kapak.alt: Exercise and falls in older adults

youtube.baslik: Does exercise really reduce falls in older adults? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In a 2019 Cochrane review of exercise programs for older adults living in the community, exercise cut the number of falls by about a quarter; the strongest evidence is for balance and functional exercises. Programs that combine balance exercise with muscle strengthening were also found effective; the Otago program, developed in New Zealand, is a good example of strength and balance exercises done at home.
